purpose: The hero menu's small art (docs/hero-screen.md): glyphs.png, twelve gold emblems on a 4 by 3 sheet (the four pages, the four command stats, the three meters, a laurel); slots.png, ten outlines for empty artifact slots on a 5 by 2 sheet; body.png, the figure the slots stand on. tools/build_hero_menu_icons.py cuts them into art/ui/runtime/hero_menu. hero_menu_mockup.png is the layout the owner picked (B, the showpiece) with the artifact page as a figure; a reference for scenes/shared/HeroSheet.gd, nothing is cut from it.
note: The PNGs are not tracked (art/*/source/**/*.png is ignored); they are in the source art archive (docs/source-material-storage-map.md) and come back with tools/restore_archived_source_material.py.

inputs: image 1: the first mockup of layout B (an edit of a screenshot of the old hero sheet on the map, with the skirmish setup column as the style reference)
